PRENATAL GENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Centre

PATIENT INFORMATION
Patient Name: [redacted name]
Date of Birth: [redacted date]
Patient ID: [redacted ID]
Maternal Age: 30 years
Gestational Age: 18 weeks
Sample Type: Amniotic fluid
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Prenatal testing requested for screening of common autosomal trisomies (chromosomes 13, 18, and 21) at 18 weeks gestation.

TEST PERFORMED
Quantitative Fluorescence Polymerase Chain Reaction (QF-PCR)

METHODOLOGY
QF-PCR analysis was performed on uncultured amniocytes extracted from amniotic fluid. The test utilizes fluorescently labeled primers to amplify short tandem repeat (STR) markers specific to chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. A minimum of four informative markers per chromosome were analyzed. Peak area ratios were calculated to determine chromosome copy number.

Markers analyzed:
- Chromosome 13: D13S631, D13S258, D13S742, D13S628
- Chromosome 18: D18S535, D18S391, D18S390, D18S386
- Chromosome 21: D21S1435, D21S1411, D21S1412, D21S1446

RESULTS
Chromosome 13: Normal diallelic pattern observed. No evidence of trisomy 13.
Chromosome 18: Normal diallelic pattern observed. No evidence of trisomy 18.
Chromosome 21: Normal diallelic pattern observed. No evidence of trisomy 21.

CONCLUSION
QF-PCR analysis demonstrates a normal complement for chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. No abnormalities detected in the tested chromosomes.

LIMITATIONS
This test is limited to the detection of trisomies of chromosomes 13, 18, and 21. It does not detect balanced chromosomal rearrangements, mosaicism below 20%, or abnormalities of other chromosomes.

FOLLOW-UP RECOMMENDATIONS
Full karyotype analysis of G-banded chromosomes from cultured amniocytes to follow. This comprehensive cytogenetic analysis will provide information about all chromosomes and can detect structural abnormalities not identified by QF-PCR.

Reported by: [redacted name], Clinical Scientist
Authorized by: [redacted name], Consultant Clinical Geneticist
